title: OPERATION CHECK OF OIL PUMP / INSTALLATION OF OIL PUMP ASSEMBLY

content.description: Illustration showing hand turning oil pump shaft counterclockwise while suction end is immersed in engine oil

items: (a) Immerse the suction end of the pump into clean engine oil and turn the shaft counterclockwise with your hand. Oil should come out of the discharge hole.

content.description: Illustration showing thumb closing discharge hole while turning pump shaft

items: (b) Close the discharge hole with your thumb, and turn the shaft as before. The shaft should be difficult to turn.

content.description: Illustration showing oil pump assembly installation with oil pipe and mounting bolt locations

items: (a) Install the oil pump and mounting bolt. Torque the bolt.
(b) Install the oil pipe with gasket lock washer and union bolt. Tighten the oil pipe union bolt and nut.

content.component: Oil pipe union bolt and nut

content.description: Diagram showing oil pan bolt tightening sequence with points labeled A, B, and C in a specific pattern

items: (a) Remove any packing material and be careful not to drop the oil on the contacting surfaces of the oil pan and cylinder block.
• Using a razor blade and gasket scraper, remove all the packing (FIPG) material from the gasket surfaces.
• Thoroughly clean all components to remove all the loose material.
• Clean both sealing surface with a non-residue solvent.

content.text: CAUTION: Do not use a solvent which will affect the rubber parts.

items: (b) Apply seal packing to the cylinder block installing surface of the oil pan.
(c) Install the oil pan over the studs on the block with the twenty four bolts and two nuts. Torque the bolts and nuts.
